comment: apply.c use_whip() 3102: a debug Valkyrie wields a wished bullwhip, walks two squares from the up staircase (stairs count as furniture to wrap the whip around), wishes a pit, steps off and back in, and creates a lichen beside her (^G). Applying the whip at the small lichen from inside the pit, with no boulder or furniture there, goes to the whip attack (3102). 3144-3145 (a hider brought out of hiding; makemon() hides eels and snakes only during level creation, makemon.c 1322-1325) and 3214-3229 (snatching a cockatrice corpse from a gloved monster) are not covered.
